issues.title: Design mapping permissions model
issues.body: We (Ian) will need to design the permissions data model for editing mapping data. Roles will have some combination of [Add/Delete], [Move/Resize], [Edit all props], [Edit user editable props]. Umpire permissions apply to shapes of all forces, other forces only control their own.
